data.exact_reserve_text: The 2020 and prior years of account were reinsured externally via a reinsurance to close with Riverstone Syndicate 3500 in 2023. Following the reinsurance to close of 2020 and prior by Riverstone Syndicate 3500, the Syndicate currently has only three years of development to report. The claims development information will be increased to ten years over time.

data.standardized_narrative: Gross claims outstanding opened at GBP 811.6m. During 2023 Syndicate 1200 experienced a material structural movement when the 2020 and prior years were reinsured to close to Riverstone Syndicate 3500 (reducing gross claims outstanding by GBP 347.8m). Excluding that reinsurance-to-close transaction, the prior-year development for the remaining prior underwriting years (notably the 2021 year) was effectively flat on the gross claims development triangle. Prior years have been influenced historically by severe weather events (e.g. Hurricanes Ian and Ida) and geopolitical events in Ukraine, but no additional quantified adverse gross reserve strengthening for prior years is evident in the gross development data.

data.data_quality_notes: The dominant structural adjustment in 2023 was the reinsurance-to-close of 2020 & prior into an external syndicate (Riverstone Syndicate 3500) which removed GBP 347.8m of gross claims outstanding from the balance sheet and distorts direct year-on-year reserve comparisons. The gross claims development triangle is present but has limited years (2021-2023) due to the RITC; the triangle was used to assess prior-year development for 2021 and indicated effectively no further gross movement on the previous diagonal. Some table rows in the PDF parsing were irregularly formatted; triangle-derived calculations are therefore given with moderate confidence.
